notes: Background: Nimbus builds an IDE copilot that supports real-time completion + background indexing for large monorepos (polyglot).
Primary ask: low-latency streaming responses in-editor (<=80ms median for suggestions) AND a separate high-throughput batch pipeline to refresh embeddings nightly across 3M source files.
Preferred architecture: dedicated pools for interactive inference + on-prem/private agents for embedding/indexing to meet data residency and IP requirements.
Quote from CTO: 'We need predictable tail latency in the editor — users won't wait.'
POC scope agreed: 2-week interactive latency test (hosted -> dedicated failover) + 4-week embedding refresh scale test (on-prem agent).

Security: must integrate with company SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, and provide audit logs for indexing jobs. EU customers require residency in eu-west region for code storage/indexes.
